lessons_used: Predictions are often higher than noise-corrected results, though some recent predictions underestimated gains.
No clear effect was seen for home, wait_info changes across three tests.
Evidence for sign_in, reorder changes is still thin because the two tests contradict each other.
Evidence for sign_in, copy changes is still thin as the two tests differ in significance despite both leaning positive.
Evidence for adoption, choose_path, finish, and home notification changes remains thin with only one test per specific change type.

candidates.title: Grid layout story and path selection
candidates.change: Redesign the choose_path screen into a clear grid layout displaying path choices with prominent visual cards.
candidates.why: choose_path has high drop-off (23.8%) and long mean completion time (514s), indicating users struggle to evaluate path choices.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Pet Journey
choose_path.body: Select how you want to create or pick your new desktop companion.

guard.reason: Redesigns choose_path layout while preserving both adoption and creation options.

candidates.score_note: High step drop-off (23.8%) but evidence relies only on funnel data without support tickets; high implementation cost.

candidates.title: Pet naming step before certificate creation
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated pet naming screen right after friend selection before generating the adoption certificate.
candidates.why: Adoption has high drop-off and takes 1017s on average; giving users a dedicated screen to name their pet deepens emotional connection.

new_pet_naming.headline: Name Your Desktop Companion
new_pet_naming.body: Give your pet a unique name before finalizing adoption.

guard.reason: 'new_pet_naming.components[0]': inputs may only ask for the pet's name

candidates.title: Desktop pet wake up interaction flow
candidates.change: Replace static home intro layout with an interactive stage flow where users tap a mascot to spawn their pet onto the desktop.
candidates.why: Finish step has the lowest overall completion rate at 64.8%, and 3 support emails reported confusion on how to launch or talk to the pet.

home_intro.headline: Wake Up Your Companion
home_intro.body: Click on your companion to launch them directly onto your desktop screen.

guard.reason: Redesigns the home intro interactive layout within onboarding limits.

candidates.score_note: Highest drop-off step (35.2%) with clear support emails, but past finish redesigns showed virtually no effect (+0.1%).

candidates.title: Reorder sign-in screen after photo upload
candidates.change: Move sign-in screen to occur right after photo upload customization step before adoption certificate generation.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back in; placing sign-in right after pet creation ensures saved state.

guard.reason: Reorders sign-in step within onboarding, which is explicitly permitted.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from 8 support emails, but past tests of sign_in reordering show zero net lift (-0.1%).

candidates.title: Desktop pet quick start control guide copy
candidates.change: Update final screen headline and body text to clearly explain tray menu controls and key shortcuts.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets highlighted confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready on Desktop!
home_intro.body: Right-click your system tray icon to chat or hide your pet anytime. Drag your pet to move them across your screens.

guard.reason: Updates home intro copy to explain controls without altering outside pages.

candidates.score_note: Targets highest drop-off step backed by support tickets, with zero dev overhead (config copy change).

candidates.title: Adoption certificate badge reward
candidates.change: Add an official companion license badge to the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Adoption step completion is 74.5% with high average duration (1017s); rewarding completion increases onboarding momentum.

guard.reason: Replaces certificate components with a badge, losing the official stamp showing the adoption.

candidates.title: Desktop pet startup animation on waiting screen
candidates.change: Add a pet loading animation component to the waiting screen while desktop environment initializes.
candidates.why: Home waiting step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, and 3 emails reported pets failing to show up on desktop.

guard.reason: Adds a pet loading animation on the waiting screen while fulfilling its job.

candidates.score_note: Supported by emails and high duration, but 3 previous wait_info tests confirmed no meaningful effect.

candidates.title: Path selection quick decision hint
candidates.change: Add a hint on choose_path reassuring users that pet options can be customized or changed anytime in settings.
candidates.why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s, showing decision paralysis from users worried about permanent setup choices.

choose_path.hint: You can change your companion's appearance and preferences anytime in desktop settings.

guard.reason: Adds a helpful hint on choose_path without violating any base rules.

candidates.score_note: Very low cost config change targeting long completion time, though evidence lacks support tickets.

candidates.title: Centered layout for sign-in options
candidates.change: Change sign_in screen to a centered layout to focus user attention on instant login actions.
candidates.why: 2 support tickets noted sign-in stalls, and sign-in drop-off remains high at 23.1%.

guard.reason: Updates sign-in screen layout while maintaining its core functionality.

candidates.score_note: Targets sign-in drop-off (23.1%) with moderate evidence from support tickets and manageable layout cost.

candidates.title: Compact layout for photo upload step
candidates.change: Switch upload_photos layout to a compact view with focused asset dropzone.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet photo creation failing or looking wrong, requiring a clearer focused layout.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Pet Photo
upload_photos.body: Select a clear photo to generate your custom 3D desktop companion.

guard.reason: Switches upload_photos layout to compact while keeping photo selection intact.

candidates.score_note: Solid evidence from drop-off and support tickets; previous adoption changes have delivered strong positive lift.
